'''Kep-She''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. When a [[Corporate fleet (Malastare)/Legends|corporate fleet]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], Master Kep-She was first assigned to Malastare to "observe" the situation and later given command of a Republic task force to break the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]. Kep-She's task force eventually destroyed [[Trench's flagship/Legends|Trench's flagship]], defeating the corporate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at the cost of heavy casualties.

==Biography==
[[File:Trench_headshot.png|thumb|right|180px|Admiral Trench, Kep-She's adversary at the Battle of Malastare Narrows]]
Kep-She was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Kep-She was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eventually reached the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode216.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cat and Mouse}}</ref> In [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]],<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> a [[Corporate fleet (Malastare)/Legends|corporate fleet]] under the command of the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the Republic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="TCWCM" /> Kep-She was dispatched to the planet as a military "observer," along with several [[Officer/Legends|officers]] like the capable [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]].<ref name="EGW" /> Later, after Trench had repelled a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under the command of Yularen,<ref name="TCWCM" /> Master Kep-She<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" /> was assigned to lead a Republic task force to end the blockade.<ref name="TCWCM" />

The [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]] claimed many Republic lives and [[Starship/Legends|ships]], but Kep-She's task force managed to destroy [[Trench's flagship/Legends|Trench's flagship]], breaking the corporate blockade and supposedly [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Harch Admiral. Admiral Trench escaped and survived, and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWCM" />

==Powers and abilities==
Kep-She possessed the knowledge and the skills required to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master and managed to defeat the skilled Admiral Trench at Malastare.<ref name="Cat and Mouse Ep Guide" /><ref name="TCWCM" /> Before the conflict at Malastare ended violently, Kep-She was sent to "observe" the situation on the planet, albeit this was a ruse in truth.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Originally, Master Kep-She was to be mentioned as the Jedi who broke the blockade during the Battle of Malastare Narrows in "[[Cat and Mouse]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series which aired in the UK on [[March 20]], [[2010]] and later aired in the US on [[March 26]]. Master Kep-She's name was cut out of the episode, but was still mentioned in the trivia section of episode's [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|official guide]] on [[StarWars.com]]. Further information about Kep-She and the battle was revealed in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which was published in [[2012]].
